page.overview:
What is Cooling coil?

Cooling coils were weapon components used on blaster rifles such as the E-11 blaster rifle. Located on the weapon's barrel, the coils forced a liquid cooling agent known as freelol into the blaster rifle's internal capillary system to cool its vital components during use.
